Method of Attack: Malicious executable file dropped in Microsoft Teams chat to trick user into running it
Malware writes data into system registry, installs DLLs, establishes persistence on Windows machine
Trojan document attached to chat thread that takes over user’s computer when clicked
Establishes persistence through Windows Registry Run keys or startup folder entry
Collects detailed OS, hardware, and security state information
Attack Vector: Malicious executable file sent in Teams chat
Possible credential theft via phishing or partner organization compromise
